_comment: Per-environment Active Directory group-name-resolution template referenced from Section 5 (Accounts) of the Initial System Validation checklist. This file is illustrative starter content only -- it is NOT read by Invoke-ISVCollection.ps1 or New-ISVReport.ps1 automatically. Copy it to ad-group-map.json (or any name you prefer), edit the role-to-actual-group-name mappings for your domain, and use it as the config file described in the report's Appendix A when resolving generically-named roles ("Domain Admins", "Server Admins", etc.) to your environment's real AD group names.
